name: When should you hire a builder during the custom home design process?

mainEntity.name: When should you hire a builder during the custom home design process for a Los Angeles custom home?
mainEntity.text: When should you hire a builder during the custom home design process for a Los Angeles custom home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best time to hire a builder for a custom home is early in the design process, ideally before final plans are complete. Bringing the builder in during schematic design allows the team to evaluate budget, constructability, site access, long-lead materials, and permit risks before the design becomes expensive to change. This is especially valuable in Los Angeles, where hillside lots, tight setbacks, and local plan-check requirements can affect the design from the beginning. If the builder joins too late, the homeowner may fall in love with a plan that is too costly or difficult to build. Early collaboration also helps align the architect, engineer, and builder around a realistic budget. For custom homes, pre-construction input can save months and reduce redesign. Homeowners should look for a builder who is comfortable participating in design decisions, value engineering, and feasibility reviews, not just pricing finished drawings.
